judgement.reason: The product runs a separate Go API server and a Nuxt frontend server behind a Caddy proxy in one container, and Deployz runs only one web process per image.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: the start script 015.sh runs 2 long-running servers in the background (/bin/backend, node /app/server/index.mjs) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The start script 015.sh runs /bin/backend and the Nuxt server in the background beside Caddy in one container, so the finding is accurate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./uploads:/uploads (docker-compose.yml app), volume ./uploads:/uploads (docker-compose.yml worker)
reviews.reason: No shown setting moves uploaded files from /uploads to S3, so the shared uploads volume appears to hold durable user files.
